components.name: Dossier primary action
components.description: Search button; the same local treatment is used by dossier download links.
components.css: .ds-dossier-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;padding:.65rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--color-accent, #114e8a);border-radius:8px;background:var(--color-accent, #114e8a);color:var(--color-bg, #f4f3ef);font-family:var(--font-body, 'Space Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.55;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none}.ds-dossier-button:hover{filter:brightness(.94)}.ds-dossier-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #114e8a);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Claim search field
components.description: Labeled search input from the claim ledger.
components.css: .ds-claim-search{font-family:var(--font-body, 'Space Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);color:var(--color-ink, #1e1d1a);line-height:1.55}.ds-claim-search label{display:block;margin-bottom:.4rem;font-size:.9rem}.ds-claim-search input{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:.65rem .8rem;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d1c0);border-radius:8px;background:var(--color-surface, #fffdf6);color:var(--color-ink, #1e1d1a);font:inherit;caret-color:var(--color-accent, #114e8a)}.ds-claim-search input::placeholder{color:var(--color-muted, #6f6a5f);opacity:1}.ds-claim-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #114e8a);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Dossier section navigation
components.description: Wrapping anchor links between the dossier sections.
components.html: Exact claimEvidenceChallenges
components.css: .ds-dossier-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.75rem 1.5rem;padding:1rem 0;border-block:1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d1c0);font-family:var(--font-body, 'Space Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);font-size:1rem;line-height:1.55}.ds-dossier-nav a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:32px;color:var(--color-accent, #114e8a);text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:.2em;}.ds-dossier-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-dossier-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #114e8a);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Dossier decision notice
components.description: The dossier notice uses tonal separation and a border, without a shadow.
components.html:
Reliance not established

This dossier exposes recorded evidence and limited integrity checks. It does not establish permission to rely on the claim.
components.css: .ds-dossier-decision{background:var(--color-surface-raised, #fff);border:1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d1c0);border-radius:12px;padding:1rem 1.25rem;color:var(--color-ink, #1e1d1a);overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-family:var(--font-body, 'Space Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);}.ds-dossier-decision h2{font-family:var(--font-heading, 'Space Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 .4rem}.ds-dossier-decision p{font-size:.9375rem;line-height:1.65;max-width:72ch;margin:0}

components.name: Dossier check disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure with a named check, written state, and explanation.
components.html:
Signature verificationnot checked

This reader does not verify signatures.
components.css: .ds-dossier-check{margin:0;padding:.35rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d1c0);color:var(--color-ink, #1e1d1a);font-family:var(--font-body, 'Space Grotesk', 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif);font-size:1rem;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-dossier-check summary{display:list-item;list-style-position:inside;min-height:44px;cursor:pointer;padding:.7rem 0;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5}.ds-dossier-check summary strong{margin-inline-end:1rem}.ds-dossier-check summary:hover{color:var(--color-accent, #114e8a)}.ds-dossier-check summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-accent, #114e8a);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-dossier-check-state{display:inline-block;font-size:.8125rem;text-transform:capitalize;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d1c0);border-radius:6px;padding:.15rem .55rem}.ds-dossier-check-state[data-check-state="failed"]{font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}.ds-dossier-check p{margin:0 0 .75rem;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.65;max-width:72ch}

components.name: Dossier JSON record
components.description: Expanded record content preserves whitespace and wraps long values.
components.css: .ds-dossier-json{white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-height:36rem;overflow:auto;background:var(--color-surface-raised, #fff);color:var(--color-ink, #1e1d1a);padding:1rem;border:1px solid var(--color-border, #d8d1c0);border-radius:8px;font:.8125rem/1.65 var(--font-mono, 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);scrollbar-color:var(--color-muted, #6f6a5f) var(--color-surface-raised, #fff)}

narrative.overview:
This reference records the public claim dossier, claim ledger, and shared SAB shell as implemented. The shared palette and declared font stacks come from `agora/tailwind.css` and its compiled `agora/static/web.css`; the local reading patterns come from `agora/static/dossier.css` and `agora/static/reliance.css`. Tokens prefixed `dossier-` apply to claim inspection, not to every route.

The views use a text-led document layout: headings, prose, labeled facts, ruled records, and native disclosures. Cream surfaces and a blue accent form the light theme; navy surfaces and a teal accent form the dark theme. The feature contract remains in [Public claim inspection](docs/PUBLIC_CLAIM_DOSSIER.md).
keyCharacteristics: Shared theme variables for surfaces, text, borders, and focus.
Sans-serif interface text, serif claim prose, and monospace records.
Written states, wrapping records, and native disclosure controls.

rules.name: The Theme Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Dossier surfaces, text, borders, links, and focus outlines resolve through the shared color variables in both themes.

rules.name: The Written State Rule
rules.body: Dossier states remain written text. Failed check states additionally use bold weight and an underline; their meaning does not depend on a colored badge.
